title: Cascade works on Part sales with no See-Financial dialog when See Financial Data is already ON
custom_steps:
1. Turn on the Parts Department card.
  2. Tick Delete on Part sales.
custom_expected:
The three Part sales boxes all tick.

No 'Enable See Financial Data?' dialog appears, because See Financial Data is already on.
evidence: UI: with See Financial Data already ON, Part sales tick Delete cascades View+C&E with NO dialog.
